articles.title: OpenAI plans to bring hidden watermark for ChatGPT and Codex
articles.description: OpenAI is moving towards a system that could allow detectors to identify text produced by its AI models without placing any visible label on the page. The measure will initially target eligible users in the European Union, where new rules require AI-generated material to carry identifiable signals.
